description.value: The Garden Strathcona is an independent cafe, retail shop, and events venue situated on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's historic Strathcona neighbourhood. It operates its own online shop and hosts a studio space for community events, making it more than a typical coffee stop. Touring cyclists passing through east Vancouver will find it a neighbourhood anchor with a local, independent character.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 74m. Total: 8 spaces.

OSM supplies the address and amenity=cafe tag but no amenity-specific tags, so all individual amenity fields default to null.
